params.name: applicationType
params.description: Application type to filter by. Can be repeated to include multiple types. Defaults to all four types.

params.name: dateFrom
params.description: Lower bound (inclusive) for the application date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: dateTo
params.description: Upper bound (inclusive) for the application date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: accountId
params.description: Filter by one or more account IDs. Can be repeated.

params.name: linkId
params.description: Filter by one or more link IDs. Can be repeated.

params.name: investmentId
params.description: Filter by one or more investment IDs. Can be repeated.

params.name: institutionId
params.description: Filter by one or more institution IDs. Can be repeated.

items.docs: Returns the consolidated detail of all investment applications across the available application types (committed, fund, deposit, COE). Supports filtering by application type, date range, account, link, investment and institution. Results are paginated.
